build_image_retrieval_inferencer: build an ImageRetrievalInferencer with a model name, prototype directory, and prototype cache path
run_image_retrieval_inference: run image retrieval inference on input images using the ImageRetrievalInferencer call method with topk parameter
save_prototype_features: save the prepared prototype features to a pickle file using the save_prototype method
visualize_retrieval_results: visualize image retrieval results with match scores, topk matches, and optional output directory
list_image_retrieval_models: list all available image retrieval model names using the list_models static method with an optional pattern
